About this direction

Following Acoem’s branding, this direction sets the stage for a calm, precise and confident presence on the web — assured rather than loud, letting proven results do the talking. Nothing at the heart of the brand has changed: the colours and typefaces are Acoem’s own. What’s new is how each one is presented.

Depth comes from colour, not shadow: Navy, Slate, Sky and Smoke separate every surface, with Coral kept as a signal for action. Movement is smooth and unhurried, like well-maintained machinery running exactly as designed.

Products are shown in the hands of the people who rely on them, each feature given its own space. Clean, modern and quietly premium — a reliable partner whose quality shows in the details.

How it works · Condition monitoring service

01

Assess your site

Our engineers walk the plant with your team, rank every asset by criticality and agree what to monitor, and how often.

  • Site audit
  • Asset criticality
  • Monitoring plan
02

Measure & baseline

Certified technicians collect vibration, alignment and balancing data on every route, setting a baseline for each machine.

  • Route-based data
  • Wireless sensors
  • Baseline report
03

Diagnose the root cause

Acoem analysts and Accurex AI review the data, pinpoint developing faults and explain exactly what is wrong, and why.

  • Vibration analysis
  • AI diagnostics
  • Severity ranking
04

Act, verify & improve

You get clear, prioritised repair actions. After the fix, we measure again to confirm it, and train your team to do it in-house.

  • Work orders
  • Post-repair check
  • Training
